headline: Substrate Leader Embroiled in Origin-Washing Scandal Affects Peers; Tong Tzu-hsien Says Kinsus Has "One Advantage", No Need to Worry | Finance | SETN.COM
summary: Prosecutors searched Kinsus Interconnect Technology on suspicion of shipping printed circuit board products made at its Chinese plant back to Taiwan and relabeling them as Made in Taiwan. Kinsus shares fluctuated sharply.
why: Kinsus makes ABF substrates, the high-end packaging materials used in advanced semiconductor chips. Country-of-origin rules affect tariffs, export compliance and customer trust in suppliers.
